inspiration: A gentle self-care companion loop informed by Finch-style mechanics; original cat characters, art, world, and names.

source_research_metadata.subject: Finch: Self-Care Pet
source_research_metadata.research_scope: Extensive feature and product-system research on Finch, with particular attention to the self-care loop, virtual pet, birbhouse/room decorating, furniture, clothing and appearance customization, shops/economy, micropets, seasonal events, quests, social systems, premium features, data/backups, accessibility-adjacent controls, and current August 2026 content.
method: Prioritized Finch's official Help Center, official App Store listing, and official Google Play listing for current product behavior.
Used the Finch community wiki only where official documentation does not expose a detailed item taxonomy, such as clothing/furniture category names.
Separated direct facts from product-analysis inferences and company claims.
Checked current store/event information on 2026-08-12 so time-sensitive details are dated.

evidence_labels.official_current: Directly documented by Finch or a current official app-store listing and reasonably current as of the research date.
evidence_labels.official_documentation: Directly documented by Finch, though the help article may have been updated in 2025 rather than 2026.
evidence_labels.official_company_claim: A statement Finch makes about its own product or outcomes; not treated as independent evidence.
evidence_labels.community_documented: Documented by the Finch community wiki; useful for detailed inventory taxonomy but may lag the live app.
evidence_labels.analytical_inference: A synthesis or product-design conclusion inferred from the documented systems rather than a feature claim made verbatim by Finch.

limitations: Finch changes frequently, including seasonal rewards, shop pools, event-exclusive items, pricing experiments, and feature trials.
The exact complete live inventory of every clothing and furniture item is much larger and more volatile than the stable feature architecture documented here.
App-store rating counts and rankings are snapshots and will change.
Some granular cosmetic category names come from the community wiki because Finch's Help Center describes the systems without publishing a full taxonomy.

No Finch-specific randomized controlled trial demonstrating clinical efficacy surfaced in this research; store and company statements about mental-health improvement should be interpreted as product claims rather than clinical proof.

sourceData.allowed_use: Comparative inspiration only. Do not copy Finch branding, terms, monetization, or exact event names into OurSpace.

adapted_patterns_for_ourspace.ourspace_interpretation: Selected organizer/self-care/skill actions can produce optional Onyx acknowledgement or rewards, while tools remain useful with Onyx disabled.
Avoid punishment for missed days; allow pause/low-sensory/reduced-motion and user-controlled reminders.

adapted_patterns_for_ourspace.finch_pattern: room/clothing customization as persistent reward layer
adapted_patterns_for_ourspace.ourspace_interpretation: Onyx room materials/furniture/cosmetics and profile/store customization can give visible persistence to optional rewards.
Organizer and Skills may group goals/practices into user-defined areas without importing Finch taxonomy.
Diary Card, Home Journal and Onyx responses can interoperate by explicit user action, while remaining distinct data domains.
Allow content/motion suppression and companion pause without deleting data or blocking Mental Health tools.
Shared profile/organizer features can support encouragement and shared goals without public competition.

useful_design_patterns: goal areas organize routines without making them punitive

coreLoop: Choose an achievable real-world self-care action
Perform it (or record a supported partial step)
Earn the task’s fictional copper once
Onyx, Callie, and Harvey respond with their own personalities
Care for all three cats voluntarily
Decorate, visit the world, unlock milestones without punitive streaks

world.autonomy: cats live autonomously; player must explicitly assign work
world.miniGame: Picnic Panic is started only from Jobs > Set Up Picnic Panic
world.selfCareIntegration: Human goals are separate from cat game jobs; completing them may award account rewards after authorization.

bondMilestones.title: Seven days with at least one check-in
A growing bond with all three cats

syncBoundaries.currentGameGuide: Local frontend wallet is not already connected to OurSpace backend.
